action_presentations.description: Switches to the saved dagger discipline loadout.
Switches to the saved two-handed weapon discipline loadout.
Switches to the saved sword-and-shield discipline loadout.
Switches to the saved bow discipline loadout.
Switches to the saved staff discipline loadout.
A reliable greatsword strike that opens pressure and spends Rage.
A low-damage greatsword strike that heavily slows the target.
Launches a grounded target into the air with an upward greatsword strike.
Crushes the target with the first step of a rising greatsword sequence.
Shatters enemies in front of the warrior, stunning them briefly.
Drives a cone of ice spikes forward from the caster.
Finishes the chain with a sweeping greatsword storm.
Spins through nearby enemies with a broad greatsword attack.
Lunges forward with a stagger-focused slash.
Sweeps across the front arc for dependable area pressure.
A rising greatsword cut that deals more damage as the target's health drops.
A hammering overhead chop that softens the target. Stacks up to 5 times; each stack makes the target take 5% more damage from every attacker.
A low-to-high dagger cut that adds a Bleed stack. Bleed damage escalates with stacks, but high stacks decay faster.
A committed lunging strike.
Leaps into the target with a heavy earth-splitting blow.
Launches a homing fire projectile at the target.
Launches a fast flaming orb at the target.
Launches a fast lightning bolt at the target.
Sends a low slash projectile across the ground at the target.
Forms and releases a fast ice projectile at the target.
Creates short-lived electric sparks that circle the caster.
Summons up to five fiery orbs that spread evenly around the caster and explode on contact.
Calls a fiery comet down at the targeted ground location.
Strikes the targeted ground location with lightning.
Bursts magma from the targeted ground location.

Lightning spell critical strikes store 40 damage, up to five times, and transform Capacitor into Discharge. Discharge releases all stored damage to enemies in an 18-meter by 2.5-meter column through the target.
Drives a delayed spike of ice through the targeted ground location.
Damages each enemy hit for 5% of its maximum health, then heals the caster for the confirmed damage dealt if the orb returns.
Launches a slow orb that hinders the target's movement.
Steals a hostile target's soul after a 2-second cast. While carrying the soul, press this ability again to arm Empower for your next damaging Mortality spell.
A stolen soul is ready. Press Soulstealer again to Empower your next damaging Mortality spell.
Your next damaging Mortality spell deals 50% more damage.
Maintains a necrotic field that damages nearby enemies each second.
Curses a targeted area for 10 seconds. Enemies within move 10% slower, receive 10% less healing, and deal 10% less damage.
Reaps one stack from a single debuff and restores 5% of the caster's maximum health.
Hurls a returning scythe that rapidly deals physical damage within its moving blade.
Erupts bone spikes at the targeted area after 0.5 seconds, dealing 30 physical damage, slowing enemies by 25% for 3 seconds, and adding a Bleed stack with 3 base damage per second.
Sends a 4.5-meter-wide wave of bones 12 meters forward, dealing 24 physical damage, slowing enemies by 25% for 3 seconds, and adding a Bleed stack with 3 base damage per second.
Conjures a triangular bone prison for 8 seconds. Hostile enemies caught inside cannot cross its walls, but the prison does not block line of sight or projectiles.
Sacrifices 20 health to restore 50 mana. Cannot be cast when the sacrifice would be lethal.
Grants brief immunity to movement slows.
Grants temporary hitpoints for a short duration.
Breaks intimidation and fear effects on the wielder.
Briefly reduces incoming damage, scaling stronger at lower health.
Rallies the wielder, increasing all damage dealt.
Releases a burst of ice around the caster.
Unleashes an arcane explosion around the caster.
Charges and releases a focused arcane beam at the target.
Channels lightning into the target for a short duration.
Channels a sustained jet of fire in a column in front of the caster for up to 4 seconds, dealing 6 fire damage every 0.2 seconds.
Channels a rapid stream of cold splinters into the target.
Channels a blizzard over the targeted area for 4 seconds, dealing frost damage every 0.5 seconds and slowing enemies by 50%.
Channels a rapid stream of arcane missiles into the target.
Channels holy energy into an ally, restoring 1 health per second for up to 5 seconds.
Protects an ally, reducing damage taken by 50% for 5 seconds.
Releases an arcane pulse that disrupts hostile magic.
Flares with light, causing hostile targeted abilities to miss briefly.
Impales the target with cold damage and freezes them briefly.
Roots nearby enemies in ice.
Tears a mass of stone from the earth for 4 seconds, blocking movement and line of sight.
Enlarges a party member or yourself to 150% size for 20 seconds, increasing physical damage by 20% and adding 1.5 meters to non-gap-closer melee attack range.

Surrounds a party member or yourself with quickening winds for 20 seconds. Auto attacks gain a weapon-speed-scaled chance to trigger additional ghostly attacks, and each Flurry attack can trigger another.
Blasts enemies in a frontal cone, knocking them backward without dealing damage.
Strikes the target with a burst of air, interrupting its current cast.
Blasts a nearby enemy with primal earth, dealing physical damage and stunning it for 1 second.
Blasts a nearby enemy with a crushing tide, dealing physical damage and purging one buff.
Blasts a nearby enemy with lava, dealing fire damage and burning it for additional damage over time.
Blasts a nearby enemy with compressed wind, dealing physical damage and knocking it backward.
Two nature spirits orbit you while you live. Bestow one instantly on another assistable player; each bestowed spirit restores 1 health per second to its holder, and both can stack on one host.
Taking magical damage grants 2% resistance to that exact damage type for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times independently per type. Adaptation cannot be dispelled.
Permanently increases a party member's or your maximum health by 10%. This magical buff can be dispelled.
After standing still for 1 second, gain 1 additional mana per second. Gain another stack each stationary second, up to 5; moving clears all stacks.
Increases a party member's or your movement speed by 10% for 15 seconds.
Using a movement ability advances the cooldowns of your other movement abilities by 2 seconds.
Creates a primal spring for 5 seconds. You and party members standing within it restore 5 health and 5 mana each second.
Hardens your body for 8 seconds, reducing physical damage taken by 50%.
Sheds all slows and snares, along with Stoneskin and Adaptation armor effects.
Drenches an area for 3 seconds, cleansing fire effects and Dousing everyone within. Doused targets resist 20% fire damage but take 20% more cold and lightning damage.

Sends a damaging 4.5-meter-wide crack homing toward your target for up to 18 meters before it erupts for 30 physical damage in a 1-meter radius. Enemies hit by either the crack or eruption are stunned for 1 second.
Shakes a targeted area for 5 seconds. Enemies within are slowed by 50%, and each has an independent 25% chance each second to be stunned for 0.5 seconds.
Seals a friendly target's wounds with fire, removing all bleed and poison effects and searing the target for 5% of their maximum health.
Wraps an ally in celestial wings, granting immunity to slows, roots, and knockbacks for 5 seconds.
Creates a holy refuge for 8 seconds. Enemies cannot enter, hostile projectiles are intercepted, and hostile area spells cannot overlap it.
A deliberate 2.5-second prayer that restores 60 health to an assistable target for 15 mana.
A balanced 1.5-second heal that restores 40 health to an assistable target for 20 mana.
A swift 0.5-second heal that restores 25 health to an assistable target for 25 mana.
Projects a 20-meter aura that restores 1 health every 2 seconds and grants 0.5 additional mana regeneration per second to the caster and nearby party members.
Surrounds a friendly target with a holy barrier that absorbs up to 100 damage for 20 seconds.
A holy barrier absorbs incoming damage.
Interrupts the target's current spell from range. A successful interrupt deals 30 holy damage.
Instantly smites a hostile target for 30 holy damage.
After a 1.5-second cast, deals 40 holy damage to a hostile target or heals a non-hostile target for 40 health. A successful landing also deals 20 damage to the caster.
Marks an enemy for 5 seconds. When the mark expires, it deals holy damage equal to 100% of the confirmed health damage you took during that window.
When this mark expires, its caster retaliates with the health damage they took during the window.
Transfers every active debuff from an assistable target onto the caster, preserving each debuff's remaining duration and stacks.
For 10 seconds, the caster takes 25% of the target's incoming damage while the target takes the remaining 75%.
The caster bears 25% of this target's incoming damage.
Passive: increases mana regeneration by 2 mana per second.
Instantly scorches the target for 30 fire damage.
Consumes all magical damage-over-time effects on the target, dealing their remaining damage instantly as arcane damage.
Instantly removes one magical buff from the target.
Instantly teleports the caster up to 15 meters forward, stopping safely before obstacles.
Prevents the target from casting spells for 5 seconds without impairing attacks or movement.
Redirects incoming damage to mana for 10 seconds, absorbing up to 100 damage at one mana per damage.
Reduces all incoming damage by 50% for 3 seconds.
Arms Recall to store the next non-instant spell you successfully cast. Cast Recall again to release that spell instantly for no mana; Recall then enters a 60-second cooldown.
Instantly swaps positions with the target and cancels any movement the target has in progress.

Surrounds a friendly target with three mirror images for 20 seconds. Each image independently has a 25% chance to intercept a single-target melee or spell attack and is destroyed when it does. Damaging area attacks destroy all images and still hit the target.
Each remaining image independently has a 25% chance to intercept a single-target attack. Damaging area attacks destroy all images without preventing damage.
Passive: melee attacks deal 5 bonus fire damage and apply Burning for 5 seconds. Burning deals 1 fire damage per stack each second, stacking up to 5 times.
Passive: fire damage taken restores an equal amount of mana.

Toggle on to gain an Immolation stack immediately and every 3 seconds, up to 10. Each stack deals 1% of maximum health as fire damage each second and increases all damage dealt by 5%. Gaining a stack refreshes the shared 6-second duration; all stacks expire together.
Consumes all Immolation stacks and burning effects on the caster, detonating their remaining fire damage against enemies within 4.6 meters.
Passive: critical strikes surge with lightning, advancing all active ability cooldowns by 1 second.

Passive: using a movement ability surrounds you with quickening lightning for 5 seconds. Your next non-instant spell has 50% reduced cast time and consumes Quickening; instant spells do not consume it.

Passive: critical strikes with spells instantly fire a free Bolt at the same target. The triggered Bolt ignores its cost, cast time, global cooldown, and ability cooldown and cannot trigger Chain Reaction again.

Instant and off the global cooldown. Your next friendly or harmful ability that applies a buff or debuff Rimes those effects, preventing abilities from removing them. Rimed effects still expire naturally.
Passive: when your direct fire spells deal damage, enemies within 5 meters of the target ignite for 5 seconds. Burning deals 1 fire damage per stack each second, stacking up to 5 times.
Passive: the first melee attack against a target frozen by your spells deals 50% increased damage and removes Freeze.
Passive: each non-critical strike with a lightning spell increases your spell critical strike chance by 5 percentage points. Critically striking with any spell resets the bonus to 0%.
Instantly freezes the target for 1 second, preventing movement and actions.
Instantly slows the target by 10%, deepening by another 10% each second for 3 seconds before freezing them for 2 seconds.
Afflicts the target for 8 seconds. Direct melee hits arc their confirmed damage as lightning to one random enemy within 10 meters.
Encases a party member or yourself in advancing frost, removing stuns and granting immunity to stuns for 10 seconds.
Drives the wielder into a frenzy, increasing auto-attack speed.
After 4 seconds in combat, gains one stack each second, increasing direct damage by 2% per stack up to 50 stacks. Direct damage consumes 10 stacks and resets the delay; stacks decay out of combat.
Feeds on nearby bleeding enemies, regenerating health and mana for each within 10m.
Enrages the wielder, increasing all damage dealt by 50%.
Instantly restores 50 stamina.
Gives 100% critical strike chance for 10s, but drops armor and resistances to zero.
Enter a 5s trance that allows life loss but prevents death, keeping HP at a minimum of 1.
Consumes all bleed stacks on a hostile target to heal yourself, scaling with stacks consumed.
Releases a shockwave around the wielder.
Locks down enemies near the caster with intimidation.
Rushes to the target and generates Rage.
Rushes to the target with a committed thrust and generates Rage.
Cuts the target early, then moves backward to reset spacing.
Drives the shield into the target and purges one magic buff.
Cuts with a disciplined shield-and-sword follow-up.
Surges into the target with a guarded strike.
Answers pressure with a forceful retaliatory attack.
Strikes the target and brands them with holy damage over time.
Thrusts with holy purpose, generating mana against branded targets.
Drives sacred power through enemies in a narrow line.
For 10s, melee attacks add Bleed base damage equal to 10% of the damage dealt. Bleed damage escalates with stacks, but high stacks decay faster.
Rushes to the target.
Rushes to the target.
Lunges to the target with an authored SwordAndShield strike.
Lunges to the target and slams them with a shield stun.
Consecrates the targeted ground location, damaging and stunning enemies after a short delay.
Removes one magical debuff from a nearby ally or yourself.
Removes all independent debuffs from a friendly unit or yourself. Effects projected by an active aura remain.
Increases nearby party movement speed by 10%.
Increases mana regeneration for the wielder and nearby party members.
Increases stamina regeneration for the wielder and nearby party members.
Reflects damage to direct attackers against the wielder and nearby party members.
Increases magic resistance for the wielder and nearby party members.
Marks enemies who attack nearby friendly targets, increasing damage they take from the wielder.
Summons a holy shield to orbit the wielder.
Surround an allied player with blades for 7.5 seconds, blocking incoming projectiles. Does not block melee attacks, beams, or area effects.
Unleashes a burst of holy light in a cone before the wielder.
Brands an enemy with holy damage over time.
Draws and releases a focused bow shot.
Fires three arrows in sequence; moving cancels every shot that has not yet released.
Looses two arrows in a single draw; both land in under half a second.
Fires a shot and moves backward to reset spacing.
Fires a shot and moves backward to disengage.
Leaps into the air and evades incoming damage while firing a shot.
Passive: deal 15% increased damage while no allied player is within 10 meters.
Passive: damage increases as the target gets closer, reaching 30% increased damage within melee range.
Passive: deal 15% increased damage to stationary targets.
Fires a high-damage precision shot that automatically critically strikes stationary targets.
Targets a circular area and sends a rain of arrows down on enemies within it.
Hold to pour arrows into the target, four a second. Every arrow loosed burns mana; releasing the key, running dry, or moving ends the volley.
Passive: targeted bow projectiles pierce every enemy in their path and stop only on terrain or environmental obstacles.
Toggles between short draw and full draw auto attack modes.
A fast close-range dagger cut.
A swift, precise dagger slice.
Dashes to the target for a quick dagger strike.
A spinning dagger strike that staggers the target without displacing it.
Rips the target with crossed daggers, adding a Bleed stack whose damage escalates at higher stacks.
Strike for 24 physical damage and slow the target by 25% per stack for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times. All stacks share one duration; applying Sever at 2 stacks refreshes that duration.

A low-cost paired cut that deals 12 physical damage and refreshes the authored duration of one random active Bleed debuff on the target without adding a stack or delaying its next tick. Costs 10 stamina.
Strike for 20 physical damage and make the target take 1 physical damage per stamina spent for 8 seconds. Costs 20 stamina.
Spins through nearby enemies with a sweeping dagger slash.
Unleashes a rapid flurry of alternating dagger strikes.
Carves the target with a precise two-blade flourish.
Rushes to the target and strikes with both daggers.
Brings both daggers down in a decisive slash.
Strikes a vulnerable nerve, stunning the target for 4 seconds.
Teleports behind a disabled target before delivering a descending execution strike.
Places two measured dagger cuts at the target's defenses and applies 1 Vulnerable stack.
Drives both daggers through the target in a brutal paired strike.
Consumes 1 Vulnerable stack on the target, increasing this attack's damage by 50%.
Your next attack that consumes Vulnerable consumes all available stacks instead. Each stack grants that attack's authored bonus; Vital Strike gains 50% damage per stack. 60 second cooldown.
Instantly set a hostile target to 3 Vulnerable stacks, the maximum. 120 second cooldown.
Rushes to the target and descends into a decisive crossing dagger strike.
Dives to the target and finishes with a descending dagger impact.
Rips both blades upward through the target.
Channels a sustained series of close dagger cuts; movement cancels the attack.
Become shrouded for 5 seconds. Attacking or taking direct damage ends Shroud. 60 second cooldown.
Deal 15% increased damage to enemies disabled by stun, freeze, fear, intimidation, confusion, stagger, or knockdown.
Mark a hostile target. Your next casted ability against that target is guaranteed to critically strike; auto-attacks do not consume the mark.
Your next damaging non-auto-attack Technique inflicts a Bleed for an additional 50% of its damage over 5 seconds.
Passive: targets hit by an attack made from Shroud are stunned for 2 seconds.
Disarm a hostile target for 4 seconds, preventing weapon attacks and hiding their weapon while leaving movement and spellcasting available.
Prevent a hostile target from using targeted abilities for 4 seconds and apply 1 Vulnerable stack. Area effects and self-casts remain available.
Confuse a hostile target for 5 seconds, taking away their control and making them wander unpredictably in a small area. Any damage ends Confusion.
Passive: deal 15% increased damage while behind the target.
Passive: reduce Dodge recharge time by 20%.
Passive: using Dodge, a gap closer, or a teleport leaves a shade at your starting location for 3 seconds. Recast that ability at no cost to return. Only one shade can exist at a time.

For 2 seconds, counter the next melee strike or hostile projectile that would hit you. A melee attacker is stunned for 3 seconds; a projectile is reflected to its caster. The countered hit deals no damage. The 24 second cooldown begins when the window ends or the counter is spent.
Sweep every enemy within 4 meters off their feet, stunning them for 2 seconds. Trip is off the global cooldown and has its own 15 second cooldown.
Passive: auto attacks restore stamina, and only auto attacks can trigger this perk. Restore 4 stamina per second of the attack's current swing cadence, so slower attacks restore more.
Passive: every fifth attack or spellcast deals 30% bonus damage. Auto attacks do not advance the count and cannot receive the bonus.
Passive: Dagger auto attacks have a 10% chance to trigger a free Quick Cut that ignores resource and cooldown costs. The triggered Quick Cut advances Cadence.
Strike for 24 physical damage and gain 10% attack speed for 10 seconds. Successful hits add a stack and refresh the duration, up to 3 stacks (30%). Costs 20 stamina.
Spring 7 meters backward to reset spacing. Costs 30 stamina.
Dodge every incoming attack and spell for 3 seconds. Each attacker you dodge is left Off Balance for 6 seconds. Press again during the window to spend your reflexes on Trip.
Sweeps the legs of everyone within 4 meters, stunning Off Balance targets for 5 seconds. Only reachable by re-pressing Lightning Reflexes.
Smothers a hostile target in shadow for 5 seconds, preventing them from using targeted abilities. Area effects and self-casts remain available.
Attaches your shadow to a hostile target for 30 seconds. Press again to spend the shadow and appear directly behind them.
Spends your attached shadow to appear directly behind whoever is carrying it, at any distance. Only reachable by re-pressing Stalk.
Tears a hostile target's shadow open for 18 seconds, dealing shadow damage every 3 seconds. Each of your melee attacks on them advances the wound by one tick.
Quickly evade in the chosen movement direction.
Ready a weapon parry against incoming melee and projectile attacks.
Immune to movement slows.
Hostile targeted abilities miss.
Damage taken reduced by 50%.
Immune to slows, roots, and knockbacks.
Immune to stuns.
Size increased to 150%. Physical damage increased by 20%, and non-gap-closer melee attack range increased by 1.5 meters.
Auto attacks can trigger additional ghostly attacks. The flat chance is 15% at a 3.5-second weapon cadence and decreases for faster attacks; Flurry attacks can trigger again.
Resistance to this magical damage type is increased by 2% per stack. Cannot be dispelled.
Maximum health increased by 10%.
Mana regeneration increased by 1 per second per stack. Moving clears all stacks.
Movement speed increased by 10%.
Physical damage taken is reduced by 50%.
Fire damage resistance is increased by 20%, but cold and lightning damage taken is increased by 20%.
Movement speed is reduced by 50% while caught in the quake.
Damage dealt increased by 10%.
Unable to move or act.
Unable to act or control movement; wanders unpredictably nearby. Any damage ends this mental effect.
Movement speed is reduced. Additional stacks increase the slow.
Takes fire damage over time.
Takes fire damage over time from Lava Blast.
Takes stacking fire damage over time.
Burns for stacking fire damage over time after a nearby fire spell lands.
Takes holy damage over time.
Takes holy damage over time.
Melee attacks add to the escalating Bleed stack pool.
Mana regeneration is increased.
Stamina regeneration is increased.
Direct attackers take thorns damage.
Magic resistance is increased.
Enemies who attack this target are marked for vengeance.
Damage taken from the aura source is increased.
Unable to move.
Frozen solid and unable to move or act.
Movement speed is increasingly reduced as the cold deepens.
Direct melee hits arc lightning to a nearby enemy.
Deals increasing fire damage to the caster while increasing all damage dealt by 5% per stack.
The next non-instant spell has 50% reduced cast time. Instant spells do not consume this effect.
Your next friendly or harmful ability that applies a buff or debuff makes those effects impossible for abilities to remove.
Unable to move or act.
Interrupted and briefly shoved back.
Knocked down and unable to act.
Dodging every incoming attack and spell.
Overcommitted on a dodged attack. Vulnerable to Trip.
Blinded by shadow. Targeted abilities cannot be used.
Carrying an assassin's shadow. They can step to you from anywhere.
A torn shadow bleeding shadow damage. The caster's melee attacks advance it.
Releases a poison cloud ahead of the caster for 6 seconds. Enemies inside gain a Poison stack each second.
Launches a poison projectile that deals poison damage and applies a Poison stack on impact.
Passive: melee hits have a 25% chance to apply a Poison stack.
Marks an enemy Contagious for 10 seconds. Shadow and Poison damage-over-time effects applied to it are copied to enemies within 5 meters.
New Shadow and Poison damage-over-time effects spread to nearby enemies.
Takes 2 poison damage each second per stack. Stacks up to 5 times.
Movement speed is reduced by 25% per stack. Stacks up to 2 times; all stacks share one refreshed 6-second duration.
Spending stamina deals physical damage to you at a 1:1 stamina-to-damage ratio.
Deprecated persisted effect: movement advances active Bleed timers. No current technique applies this status.
Your next attack that consumes Vulnerable consumes all available stacks.
Can be consumed by certain attacks to empower that attack.
